home.heroLead: Devia Desktop is a friendly, unified interface over multiple agentic CLI tools — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and more — that turns working with terminal agents into a visual, organized, multi-project experience.
home.heroQuote: “If Claude Code is the engine, Devia is the body and the steering wheel.”

features.title: 🤖 Multi-agent
features.body: Work with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen, DeepSeek, or Qoder, and switch agents without switching tools. Devia detects your installed CLIs and configures each project so they just work — no manual setup needed.

features.title: 💬 Visual chat over the agent
features.body: Streaming responses, markdown, expandable tool-call cards, a diff viewer, and image attachments for multimodal models.

features.title: 🪟 Multi-project and multi-session
features.body: Per-project session history, an instruction queue, and a split view with up to 4 panels — each with its own independent session and git worktree — letting multiple agents work in parallel in a single window.

features.title: 📋 Kanban with built-in SDD
features.body: A per-project board that the agent itself reads and updates via MCP (devia-kanban), with specs, tasks, dependencies, and a full spec-driven development workflow.

features.title: 🧠 Persistent memory
features.body: Devia ships with its own cross-session memory (devia-memory), scoped personally and per project, which the agent queries and feeds automatically.

features.title: 🌿 Built-in Git
features.body: Live repository status, a change viewer with inline comments for requesting agent reviews, and worktree support.

features.title: 🔌 MCP server manager
features.body: Install, enable, and share MCP servers across agents; Devia injects the configuration in each CLI's native format.

features.title: ✨ Skills and prompt packs
features.body: Discover and install skills (local or from GitHub) and define per-project system prompt packages.

features.title: 📱 Remote control via Telegram
features.body: Launch runs, check status, and chat with the agent from Telegram, with optional mirroring of the desktop conversation.

features.title: 🖥️ Terminal and shell
features.body: A per-project integrated terminal (real PTY), open-in-your-favorite-IDE support, and Docker Compose orchestration.

features.title: 🎙️ Voice
features.body: Local transcription with Whisper — no audio is ever sent to any API.

features.title: 🛡️ Snapshots and audit
features.body: Snapshots and rollback before destructive operations, plus an audit log of every tool-call with automatic rotation and retention.

home.localLead: Devia Desktop runs on top of your projects and your CLIs, on your machine. Your sessions, memory, Kanban board, and configuration all live on your disk (~/.devia-app/). No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry: just install, choose your working folder, and start directing agents.

steps.title: 1 · Install
steps.body: Download the installer for your platform and open it. No prior configuration required.

steps.title: 2 · Connect your agents

steps.title: 3 · Direct

paras: Devia Desktop is a desktop application for developing software with AI agents. It is a friendly, unified interface over multiple agentic CLI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more) that turns working with terminal agents into a visual, organized, multi-project experience.

It is FreeWare: free with 100% of features included, available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Everything runs locally, on top of your projects and your CLIs — no account or connection to any external service required.

win.title: Windows
steps: Download the .exe installer from the downloads page.
Run it and choose the installation directory (per-user installation, no administrator privileges needed).
If SmartScreen shows a warning, click "More info → Run anyway".

mac.title: macOS
steps: Download the .dmg for your architecture (Apple Silicon or Intel).
Open it and drag Devia into the Applications folder.
The app is signed and notarized by Apple: it opens with no additional steps.

linux.title: Linux
steps: AppImage: download it, make it executable with chmod +x Devia-*.AppImage, and run it.
Debian/Ubuntu: install the package with sudo dpkg -i devia_*_amd64.deb.

Choose your workspace. The first time you open Devia, a modal asks for the root folder where your projects live (for example, ~/repos). Devia lists the projects it finds and detects their technology stack.
Connect an agent. Devia detects the agentic CLIs installed on your machine and lets you choose the active agent in Settings. Each project is configured so the agent works with no manual adjustments.

Chat. Open a project and type your first instruction in the composer. Choose the execution mode — plan (plan only), apply (apply with permissions), or apply-yolo (no confirmations) — depending on how much autonomy you want to grant.
Review. Each response streams in with markdown, tool calls expand into cards, and the agent's changes appear as inline diffs.

rows.notes: Full integration, including per-run MCP servers

agentes.handoff: When continuing a session with a different agent than the one that started it, Devia performs an automatic context handoff: it injects a summary of the work (goal, files touched, and recent exchanges) into the new agent's first turn and places a divider in the chat.

groups.title: Multi-project and sessions
items: List, create (blank or from a template), and clone projects; pin favorites to the sidebar.
Per-project session history that survives restarts; resume or restart a session with one click.
Instruction queue: queue prompts while the agent is busy, reorder with drag and drop, pause and resume.

groups.title: Multi-session split view
items: Up to 4 panels (2×2) in the same window, each with its own session and its agent working in parallel.
Each additional panel works isolated in its own git worktree (a new branch from the main branch) so two agents never step on the same files.
The split and its worktrees survive app restarts, restoring each session's files.

groups.title: Kanban with built-in SDD
items: Per-project Kanban board with specs, tasks, and dependencies.
The agent itself reads and updates the board via MCP (devia-kanban): end-to-end spec-driven development workflow.
Board state lives outside the repository, in Devia's data folder.

groups.title: Persistent memory
items: Cross-session memory (devia-memory) scoped personally and per project.
The agent queries and feeds it automatically: decisions, resolved bugs, and discoveries are all recorded.
Management panel in Settings: search, pin, forget, or clear observations.

groups.title: Built-in Git
items: Live repository status in the sidebar.
Change viewer with inline comments: annotate diff lines and send them to the agent as a review request.
Worktree support and snapshots with rollback before destructive operations.

groups.title: MCP servers, skills, and prompts
items: Model Context Protocol server manager: install, enable, test, and share servers across agents; Devia injects the configuration in each CLI's native format.
Discover and install local or GitHub-hosted skills.
Prompt packs: per-project system prompt packages.
Reusable multi-CLI sub-agent manager, shared across projects.

groups.title: Remote control via Telegram
items: Launch runs, check status (branch, context used, cost), and chat with the agent from Telegram.
Optional mirroring of the desktop conversation and forwarding of attachments (photos, documents) to the agent.

groups.title: Terminal, voice, and more
items: Per-project integrated terminal with a real PTY, and open-in-your-favorite-IDE support.
Docker Compose orchestration: deploy, down, and logs per project.
Local voice transcription with Whisper — audio never leaves your machine.
Drag-and-drop image attachments for multimodal models.
Project file browser in the right rail and an archive of files generated by the agent (outbox).
Audit log of every tool-call with rotation and a 30-day retention policy.
11 languages (es, en, ca, fr, de, it, pt, ru, zh, hi, ar), 8 Material 3 accent palettes, and adjustable font size.

items.a: Yes. Devia Desktop is FreeWare with 100% of features included, on all platforms.

items.q: Do I need an account or a connection to any Devia service?
items.a: No. Devia Desktop works entirely locally. The only external services used are those of the CLI agents you have configured yourself.

items.q: Does Devia include the AI agents?
items.a: No — Devia is the interface that directs them. You need at least one agentic CLI installed (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…) with its credentials. Devia detects them and takes care of the rest.

items.q: Does my data leave my machine?
items.a: No. Sessions, memory, Kanban boards, and configuration all live in ~/.devia-app/. Voice transcription with Whisper also runs locally. The only thing that travels is what the CLI agent you use sends to its own provider.
Spanish, English, Valencian, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Hindi, and Arabic.

items.q: How do I report an issue?
items.a: Open an issue in the Devia GitHub repository with the steps to reproduce it and your platform (Windows/macOS/Linux).
